dataList.content:
A T Corp. Staff in a different uniform approached the Sinners as both sides went on the defensive.
冲突刚刚缓解了一些，立刻又有不同着装的T公司员工靠近了罪人们。
dataList.place:
Alleyways of T Corp.
T公司小巷 某处

dataList.content:
Is this one their ringleader?
……那群家伙的头领吗？

He may be of a higher rank, but he is but an employee of T Corp. all the same.
就算等级再高，他也只是T公司的员工，并不是那种概念……

Which is to say that our insistence on meeting their demands with hostility may lead to a direct confrontation against the full force of T Corp...
与他们继续争执下去的话，会发展成对抗整个T公司的状况……

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Lay down your weapons, now.
立刻停止战斗。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Should you refuse to cooperate, all of you present may be considered hostile individuals by T Corp., and we will use force to...
如若拒绝合作，所有在场人员将被视为敌对势力并受到武力镇压……

Heh heh... I like that. How thrilling.
呵呵……变得有趣起来了。

Ah... this is bad...
啊……这样的话……

<This seems like a great time for Vergilius with his intimidating, glowing eyes to—>
<是时候轮到维吉里乌斯瞪着他那可怕的眼睛……从哪里……>

—appear.
出现了。

Man, weren't things much better between us and the guide bud only a few days ago? Feels like it's been forever since then.
明明几天前还觉得和向导先生之间和谐的氛围能维持下去……可现在却觉得那是很遥远的事了。

C'mon, don't glare at us like that. We had our reasons, 'kay? They showed up outta nowhere and tried to extort a whole ten billion Ahn—
别用那种眼神盯着我们了，你听我们解释。真的是冤枉啊~这人可是突然要我们交出100亿眼啊~

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Ten-billion-and-forty-million Ahn, to be exact.
共100亿4000万眼。

You really like saying that, don't ya? Geez...
你是在放录音吗？怎么老是说同样的话……

Yeah, yeah. The point is, there's no way we owe ‘em that much money! We’re kind, law-abiding citizens...
关键是，怎么可能要交那么多税呢！明明我们比谁都善良守法……

Who art brimming with a sense of Justice!
吾一直活得堂堂正正！

Hear, hear~!
没错~！

Vergilius listened quietly for a moment as the Sinners chattered on like they were a part of a comedy skit.
就像听相声一样，维吉里乌斯静静地听着罪人们的喧闹声，慢慢开口。

Yes, I agree that ten billion Ahn in taxes does seem unreasonable. However...
对，正如你们所说，100亿眼的税款听起来确实不太合理。不过。

... It is a mystery to me how no one stopped to think for a second about the troubles you might spark by starting a meaningless scuffle like this. In the middle of the street, no less.
我还以为有人想得到呢，在道路中央挑起这种无意义的争斗会引发多大的麻烦。

Mmm...
嗯……

Haaah...
哈啊……

Vergilius let out a deep sigh before turning toward the T Corp. employee.
维吉里乌斯深深地叹了口气，然后转向了T公司的员工。

... We find it regrettable that this incident has led to bloodshed.
对于这起事件引发的流血冲突，我们感到非常遗憾……

However, ten billion Ahn in Time Tax... is unacceptable.
然而，高达100亿眼的时间税……也实在让人难以接受。

I'm sure you know full well that ten billion Ahn's worth of tax isn't the kind of money that we can simply fork over in the middle of the street.
你们肯定也清楚，如此巨额的征税不是轻易就能在街头交付的。

I believe that it would have been more appropriate if you had provided us with some context as to how this number came to be, instead of immediately marching up to us and demanding that we pay the Time Tax.
比起这样突然来征收时间税，我觉得你们应该先给我们解释一下这数字是怎么来的。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
... I admit that such absurd amount of Time Tax levied upon your group is... almost unprecedented. We have been summoned to an emergency meeting in a relevant office to address the severity of this incident.
如此异常的征税报告实属罕见。我方也已意识到事态的严重性，目前已在所属辖区办公室召开紧急会议。

dataList.title:

T公司

I see your point. Why don't we move this conversation to the Collections Office in the relevant jurisdiction area for now to discuss possible solutions?
让我们移步所属辖区的征收所，进一步讨论此事发生的原因及解决方法吧。
